name: Nicodemus
bio: Nicodemus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 53).

poems.title: Book IX, 53
poems.author: Nicodemus
poems.text: Hippocrates was the light of mankind; whole peoples were saved by him, and there was a scarcity of dead in Hades.
